title: Detailed lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff59d'/>
      <stop offset='35%' stop-color='#ffe93b'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#f5d000'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4a900'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='nubGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe94d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c9a400'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft shadow under lemon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#5a6b2a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- main lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='31' ry='29' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- bottom tip -->
  <path d='M46 79 Q50 87 55 79 Q51 82 46 79 Z' fill='url(#nubGrad)'/>
  <!-- top tip -->
  <path d='M44 24 Q50 15 57 24 Q51 21 44 24 Z' fill='url(#nubGrad)'/>

  <!-- dimpled texture: light and dark speckles -->
  <g fill='#e8c400' opacity='0.55'>
    <circle cx='35' cy='40' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='45' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='31' cy='54' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='62' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='65' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='69' cy='57' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='47' cy='70' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='52' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='46' r='1.0'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='1.0'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='73' r='1.0'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fff8b0' opacity='0.75'>
    <circle cx='37' cy='37' r='1.0'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='41' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='60' r='1.0'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='55' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='61' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='51' cy='66' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='47' r='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- pore dimples (slightly indented look) -->
  <g fill='#c9a400' opacity='0.4'>
    <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='62' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='55' r='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='73' r='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='38' rx='11' ry='8' fill='url(#shineGrad)' transform='rotate(-25 38 38)'/>

  <!-- seam lines from tips -->
  <path d='M50 17 Q48 30 49 40' stroke='#e8c400' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M50 84 Q52 72 51 62' stroke='#e8c400' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
